## September Developer Feedback

September 30, 2026Author: Mickou

[![main-logo](https://gom-s3-user-avatar.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/wp-content/resources/img/return_icon.png)Back](https://www.whiteoutsurvival.wiki/category/news-en/)

September Developer Feedback

Welcome to the Tundra, Chiefs! Thank you for your trust and unwavering support! It has always been our mission to tackle challenges and optimize your gaming experience.

In the upcoming Q&A session, we’ll discuss recent hot topics and share our solutions. Let’s work together and build a better place! “

Q: Can the Bank’s Gems Deposit Period be adjusted from 1 day to 23 hours? Any delays will push the schedule back each time, making daily management inconvenient.

A: Understood! We’ll make this improvement in an upcoming update: the Bank’s Gems Deposit Period will be adjusted from 24 hours to 23 hours.

Additionally, the following Chief Order cooldowns will also be improved:

1\. “Rush Job” will be adjusted to 23 hours.

2\. “Advanced Training” and “Dawn Alliance Commendation” will be adjusted to 1 day 23 hours.

We hope these changes will help Chiefs plan their daily in-game activities more easily.

Q: Please enable Cross-State Group Chat. We’d like to remain in our original State’s chat groups after transferring to stay in touch with friends.

A: Consider it done! We plan to add Cross-State chat support after State Transfer opens in an upcoming update. We’ll also make the following improvements:

1\. Chiefs will remain in their existing chat groups after transferring states.

2\. Increase the group creation limit.

Q: Please add a feature to remove all Garrison Troops at once. When the battle gets intense, expelling Troops one by one is too slow to respond in time.

A: Great suggestion! We will add this feature in an upcoming update. Rally leaders and Chiefs with R4/R5 permissions will be able to expel all Garrison Troops with one tap, allowing Chiefs to respond quickly in intense battles.

Q: In my state, competition for Festive Name Card Skins is getting too fierce. I hope it can be obtained by reaching a certain milestone point threshold, similar to City Skins.

A: Thank you for your feedback. Starting with the upcoming 2026 Halloween Event, we plan to add a guaranteed way to obtain the Name Card. Chiefs who reach 40 million Points or rank in the top 25 will receive a Permanent Festival Name Card Skin.

Q: During the State of Power (SvS) Field Triage Phase, can the interface show which allies helped revive my troops?

A: Noted! In an upcoming update, we will add “Assistance received records” so Chiefs can easily see which allies used “Rebirth Tomes” on them.

Thank you for submitting your feedback! We look forward to hearing more feedback from our loyal players!
